-- Names come from untrusted requests, so only plain file names are allowed.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post not out or (name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1)
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Returns the text of notes/name, or "" if the name is unsafe, missing, or unreadable.
-- Only the notes directory is visible through fs; no name may reach a file outside it.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(name) else err -> ""
